# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow the shared repository rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). This file is intentionally short so Copilot-specific guidance does not drift from the common instructions.

Before making a change:
- Read [README.md](../README.md) and [the eight-stage index](../stages/README.md).
- Find the canonical task skill in [skills/README.md](../skills/README.md).
- Read the relevant engineering standard under `standards/`.
- Check [REFERENCES.md](../REFERENCES.md) before adding external guidance.

Keep skills in `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`; do not duplicate them under stage or agent folders. Preserve existing security work. Treat examples as templates unless an active workflow proves they are enabled. Report exactly which checks ran and which did not.
